name: reachinbox-email-scheduler
description: Production-grade email job scheduler: BullMQ delayed jobs, Redis-backed rate limiting, Elasticsearch search

comments.workspaces: Intentionally NOT an npm workspace. backend/ and frontend/ install independently so each Dockerfile stays a plain `COPY package*.json && npm ci`. These scripts are dev convenience only.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
